name: Filing Bankruptcy
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of financial hardship and borrowing, emphasizing mercy and fairness in lending, especially toward the poor, as seen in Exodus 22:25 and Psalms 37:21. The Bible warns that debt can place one in servitude to the lender (Proverbs 22:7) and highlights the importance of fulfilling vows and obligations (Ecclesiastes 5:5). The principle of periodic release of debts every seven years (Deuteronomy 15:1) reflects God's provision for restoration and relief, underscoring a balance between justice and compassion in financial dealings.
